rows.title: Nacar Hotel Cartagena, Curio Collection by Hilton
rows.body:
Urban, Colombia, CALA, Walled City, Lifestyle boutique

Cartagena, Colombia (Centro Histórico / Walled City)

Historic conversion · lifestyle boutique · restaurant-forward urban

Nacar Hotel Cartagena is a Curio Collection property in Cartagena's walled historic center—design-led rooms, rooftop pool, and courtyard public spaces positioned for leisure and regional transient demand in Colombia's primary coastal heritage market.

Compare this format if you are underwriting a colonial-core lifestyle conversion in CALA: authentic public spaces, F&B complexity, and design PIP—not select-service reflag economics.

Walled-city Curio assets need operator F&B discipline and design QA matched to local ADR—confirm Hilton fees, incentives, and conversion scope before you model from U.S. gateway prototypes.

https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ctgncqq-nacar-hotel-cartagena/

rows.title: Zemi Miches Punta Cana All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton
rows.body:
Resort, Dominican Republic, CALA, All-inclusive, Beachfront

Miches, Dominican Republic (Playa Esmeralda / northeast coast)

All-inclusive resort · 500 keys · multi-venue F&B and pools

Zemi Miches is Curio Collection's first all-inclusive resort in the Dominican Republic—a large-format beachfront property on Playa Esmeralda with multiple restaurants, pools, spa, and Club Azure premium tier. Distinct operating model from à la carte Curio urban or boutique formats.

If you are evaluating all-inclusive Curio, underwrite on AI package economics, F&B outlet count, and labor intensity—not urban collection or small boutique PIP assumptions.

Large AI resorts swing on occupancy and package margin—confirm Hilton program fees, AI operator capability, and air-lift leisure mix before you model from urban Curio comps.

https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pujmiqq-zemi-miches-all-inclusive-resort/
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Miches, DR: Zemi Miches—Curio's first Dominican all-inclusive, 500-room beachfront resort on Playa Esmeralda.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Capture fly-in leisure at scale with all-inclusive packaging, multi-outlet F&B, and Hilton Honors distribution.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: All-inclusive resort reference—distinct from à la carte urban, golf, or nature-lodge Curio formats.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: AI economics differ materially from lifestyle boutique Curio—model package margin, outlet labor, and seasonality, not walled-city ADR comps.

rows.title: Indura Beach & Golf Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton
rows.body:
Resort, Honduras, CALA, Golf & beach, Meetings + leisure

Tela, Honduras (Bahía de Tela / north coast)

Golf & beach resort · spa · groups and leisure

Indura Beach & Golf Resort is a Curio Collection property on Honduras' Caribbean coast—18-hole golf, beach access, spa, and meetings-capable resort product for regional leisure and group demand.

Golf-beach Curio illustrates resort-scale CALA with sports amenity capex and dual leisure/group revenue streams—confirm PIP, operator golf/F&B capability, and fee stack versus urban collection hotels.

Coastal Honduras resorts depend on regional drive and group mix—budget golf maintenance and F&B for your market's peak patterns, not only resort headline ADR.

https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/teaibqq-indura-beach-and-golf-resort/
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Tela, Honduras: Indura Beach & Golf—Curio golf-and-beach resort on the north coast with spa and meetings product.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Monetize golf, beach, and group demand with resort-scale amenities and Hilton distribution.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Golf-beach resort reference versus all-inclusive, urban, or nature-destination Curio types.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Golf resorts carry ongoing agronomy and clubhouse F&B load—match operator strength and local group pipeline before underwriting from urban Curio comps.

rows.title: Anselmo Buenos Aires, Curio Collection by Hilton
rows.body:
Urban, Argentina, CALA, San Telmo, Lifestyle boutique

Buenos Aires, Argentina (San Telmo / Plaza Dorrego)

Urban lifestyle · historic façade · modern interior · F&B forward

Anselmo Buenos Aires is a Curio Collection hotel in San Telmo—boutique scale with a historic exterior, contemporary interior, Café Anselmo and lounge F&B, and walkable access to Buenos Aires' cultural core.

Southern Cone urban Curio shows collection positioning outside Mexico/Colombia Caribbean orbit—plan for boutique F&B, design narrative, and transient/group mix in a dense international comp set.

Gateway Southern Cone assets live on location, F&B execution, and international demand recovery—confirm Hilton fees and loyalty contribution versus local independent boutique comps.

https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/buebaqq-anselmo-buenos-aires/

rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: San Telmo boutique economics depend on ADR and F&B margin in a competitive gateway—match building scale and operator F&B strength to your asset.

rows.title: Royal Palm Galapagos, Curio Collection by Hilton
rows.body:
Resort, Ecuador, CALA, Galápagos, Nature destination lodge

Santa Cruz Island, Galápagos, Ecuador (highland forest estate)

Nature lodge · low density · villas and suites · eco-sensitive destination

Royal Palm Galapagos is a Curio Collection estate on Santa Cruz Island—21 villas and deluxe rooms on a 160-hectare highland property adjacent to Galápagos National Park, positioned for ultra-nature leisure and expedition-style demand.

Destination-lodge Curio is a distinct underwriting profile: low key count, high experience capex, strict environmental constraints, and logistics-heavy operations—not beach AI or urban collection templates.

Galápagos assets require realistic transfer, permitting, and shoulder-season assumptions—confirm operator eco-compliance and Hilton program economics before you borrow from mainland resort comps.

https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/gpsrpqq-royal-palm-galapagos/
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Galápagos, Ecuador: Royal Palm—low-density Curio nature lodge on a highland estate near Galápagos National Park.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Capture high-yield nature and expedition leisure with distinctive low-density product and Hilton global reach.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Ultra-niche destination reference—distinct from mass AI, golf-beach, or gateway urban Curio types.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Nature-lodge Curio is logistics- and permit-heavy—underwrite access, staffing, and environmental compliance before using beach-resort or urban benchmarks.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Ecuador, CALA, Galápagos, Nature lodge, Resort, Curio

rows.title: Dominican Republic all-inclusive debut
rows.body:
Jun 2025

Zemi Miches Punta Cana All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton debuted on Playa Esmeralda—first Curio all-inclusive in the Dominican Republic, 500-room beachfront resort with Club Azure premium tier.

https://stories.hilton.com/releases/zemi-miches-punta-cana-all-inclusive-resort-curio-collection-by-hilton-debuts-in-the-dominican-republic

rows.title: Galápagos nature destination lodge
rows.body:
Jul 2022

Royal Palm Galapagos, Curio Collection by Hilton opened on Santa Cruz Island—Hilton’s Galápagos debut and first international hotel brand in the destination, 21-villa highland estate adjacent to Galapagos National Park.

https://stories.hilton.com/releases/royal-palm-galapagos-curio-collection-by-hilton-opens

rows.title: Cartagena walled-city lifestyle anchor
rows.body:
Dec 2020

Nacar Hotel Cartagena, Curio Collection by Hilton opened in Cartagena’s Walled City—Curio’s Colombia debut, 49-room boutique in the UNESCO historic center operated by oxoHotel.

https://stories.hilton.com/releases/colombia-welcomes-curio-collection-by-hilton

rows.title: Honduras golf & beach resort
rows.body:
Nov 2016

Indura Beach & Golf Resort joined Curio Collection by Hilton on Tela Bay—Curio’s first property in Central America, 60-suite golf-and-beach resort in Jeanette Kawas National Park.

https://www.franchising.com/news/20161110_curio_ndash_a_collection_by_hilton_debuts_fivestar.html

rows.title: Southern Cone urban lifestyle
rows.body:
Jul 2015

Anselmo Buenos Aires joined Curio Collection by Hilton in San Telmo—Curio’s first hotel in Latin America, adaptive-reuse boutique in a 1906 mansion facing Plaza Dorrego.

https://www.franchising.com/news/20150722_curio_ndash_a_collection_by_hilton_celebrates_bran.html
